results.title: India and Egypt form working group to explore trade deal contours
results.content: During his ongoing visit to Egypt, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal co-chaired, along with Egypt’s Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade Mohamed Farid Saleh, the 7th session of the India-Egypt Joint Trade Committee (JTC) in Egypt’s New Administrative Capital.

results.title: Census portal lists ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’ among 287 ‘other’ religions; removes menu later
results.content: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.
